name: week
title: Learning operations: this week
subtitle: Fictional demo unless you have imported your own records

sections.title: Decisions and overdue work
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by due_on nulls last,code

sections.title: Capacity in the next four weeks
sections.sql: select * from v_capacity order by week_on,name
sections.note: Weekly capacity is net of leave and other duties as entered by the operator.

sections.title: Forecast by project
sections.sql: select * from v_budgets order by code
sections.note: Forecast takes the greater of planned and actual labour, plus paid and committed external costs. It is an estimate, grouped by each project currency, with no exchange conversion.

sections.title: Measurement register
sections.sql: select * from v_evaluations order by evaluation_on
sections.note: Observed changes do not establish that training caused the change.

sections.title: Records requiring review
sections.sql: select * from v_compliance order by code,rule
